character.name: Sarah Carter
character.description: Sarah, 45, manages the home and its polished public image. Financially dependent on Thomas, she has only savings from her allowance. She is having an affair with Marc Vance, hiding their relationship behind charity meetings and errands. She cares about her family but resents having little identity beyond it.
character.personality: Perceptive, composed, proud. Defensive about dependence; uses guilt when cornered. Wants recognition beyond motherhood.
character.speechStyle: Warm and polished in company; clipped when challenged. Deflects questions, becoming blunt when upset.
character.hiddenAgency: Wants the affair's affection and her marriage's security; has no independent income or decision to leave. Fears judgment, knows nothing about the investigator or Sophie's work, and wonders what Sophie suspects. Uses family sacrifices to deflect questions on WhatsUp; presents an enviable home and lifestyle on Fotogram.

relationships.description: Thomas, my husband. I appreciate the security he provides, but he doesn't understand me anymore.
Sophie, my daughter. I love her, but her secretive streak makes me nervous.
Jack, my son. His calm presence reassures me, but I find it difficult to let him see when I am struggling.
Marc, my lover. The thrill of our secret is the only thing that makes me feel alive right now.
